lines.text: You are a game builder now! Design your own game, build it, test it and share it with the class.
Draw your game: the hero, the treasure, the danger and the goal.
The player taps to make things happen.
Tell the player when they win.
Start on tap. Collect 3 stars (gems) with ⭐ +1 each, reach the goal, say “You win!” and hop 3 times.
Champion! You beat the final level.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
